description: This Java source file defines the IncomingMessageView activity in an Android application. The activity displays incoming message details, retrieved from intent extras, and clears the associated notification when created.

classes.name: IncomingMessageView
classes.description: An Android activity that displays details of an incoming message and clears its notification.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Called when the activity is starting. Sets the layout, displays message details from intent extras, and cancels the notification.
